name: jp-healthcare-osm
description: 医療情報ネット オープンデータを OSM 向けに変換する作業リポジトリ

scripts.prep:hospital: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector hospital && python3 scripts/build_speciality.py --sector hospital && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector hospital && node scripts/build_addr.js --sector hospital
scripts.prep:clinic: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector clinic && python3 scripts/build_speciality.py --sector clinic && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector clinic && node scripts/build_addr.js --sector clinic
scripts.prep:dental: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector dental && python3 scripts/build_speciality.py --sector dental && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector dental && node scripts/build_addr.js --sector dental
scripts.prep:maternity: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector maternity && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector maternity && node scripts/build_addr.js --sector maternity
scripts.prep:pharmacy: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector pharmacy && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector pharmacy && node scripts/build_addr.js --sector pharmacy
scripts.build:hospital: npm run prep:hospital && npm run fix:coords && npm run osm:hospital
scripts.validate:hospital: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/build/hospital_opening_hours.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_speciality.py output/build/hospital_speciality.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/build/hospital_names.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_osm.py output/osm/hospital/hospital_osm --report-dir output/reports
scripts.build:clinic: npm run prep:clinic && npm run fix:coords && npm run osm:clinic
scripts.validate:clinic: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/build/clinic_opening_hours.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_speciality.py output/build/clinic_speciality.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/build/clinic_names.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_osm.py output/osm/clinic/clinic_osm --report-dir output/reports
scripts.build:dental: npm run prep:dental && npm run fix:coords && npm run osm:dental
scripts.validate:dental: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/build/dental_opening_hours.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_speciality.py output/build/dental_speciality.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/build/dental_names.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_osm.py output/osm/dental/dental_osm --report-dir output/reports
scripts.build:maternity: npm run prep:maternity && npm run fix:coords && npm run osm:maternity
scripts.validate:maternity: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/build/maternity_opening_hours.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/build/maternity_names.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_osm.py output/osm/maternity/maternity_osm --report-dir output/reports
scripts.build:pharmacy: npm run prep:pharmacy && npm run fix:coords && npm run osm:pharmacy
scripts.validate:pharmacy: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/build/pharmacy_opening_hours.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/build/pharmacy_names.csv --report-dir output/reports && python3 scripts/validate_osm.py output/osm/pharmacy/pharmacy_osm --report-dir output/reports
scripts.build: npm run prep:hospital && npm run prep:clinic && npm run prep:dental && npm run prep:maternity && npm run prep:pharmacy && npm run fix:coords && npm run osm:hospital && npm run osm:clinic && npm run osm:dental && npm run osm:maternity && npm run osm:pharmacy
scripts.validate: npm run validate:hospital && npm run validate:clinic && npm run validate:dental && npm run validate:maternity && npm run validate:pharmacy
scripts.selftest: node scripts/selftest.js && node scripts/selftest_addr.js && node scripts/selftest_placeholder.js && python3 scripts/selftest_osm.py && python3 scripts/selftest_split.py && python3 scripts/selftest_verify_coords.py
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run selftest && npm run validate
